symbol_ledger.definition: Time in years from today; constant effective annual interest; discount factor1/(1+i); effective discounti/(1+i); force per year ln(1+i).
Integer discrete payment count; temporary geometric sum H; payment index k. n is a real continuous duration in continuous and an analytic real term in unknown-term.
Positive level amount per payment; present value at0; unit immediate and due finite factors.
Unit immediate perpetuity, defined only i>0; N is truncation count, epsilon relative tolerance, eta absolute currency tolerance.
Fund balance immediately after payment k and initial balance at0.
Payments per year p; effective rate j per1/p year; nominal annual rate pj; annual total R distributed as R/p per payment.
Payment intensity in currency/year, differential time in years, continuous unit-intensity factor in years. R becomes the constant intensity here.
Continuously evolving fund balance, satisfying F'=delta F-R.
Value at terminal date n and continuous unit-intensity accumulated factor in years.
Deferral m in years, distinct from frequency p; deferred immediate factor; integration variable u=t-m in(8.17).
Positive loan/price L; K=floor(n); balance B_K after K full payments; finite accumulated factor s; sum index ell. K,B_K,s,ell are defined in final-payment.
Present value of receipts minus price, and secant interpolation rate estimate.
Bisection interval endpoints, initial width W, number b of halvings.
Integration width, closed integral value and independent midpoint sum.
Mean-value intermediate rate and unique root in Exercise6.
